title: Arcade Game
objective: 这是一款经典的2D无尽跑酷游戏。玩家控制一只恐龙，通过按空格键进行跳跃来躲避迎面而来的仙人掌等障碍物。目标是尽可能长时间地生存并获取最高分，撞到任何物体即导致失败。

lose_condition: the described failure condition is reached

physics.jump_or_impulse: as required by the described controls
physics.collision_style: simple playable collision matching the described game
